items.name: Strawberries, halved
items.preparation: raw, hulled and cut in half (5 halves)

items.name: Clementine / mandarin orange (whole, unpeeled)

items.name: Red seedless grapes
items.preparation: raw, loose, off the stem (~20 grapes)

scale_cues: Square white dinner plate (about 25 cm across). The clementine is about a quarter of the plate's width, so about 6–6.5 cm across. Grapes are about 2 cm each. I counted the pieces of fruit to estimate their weight.
assumptions: Clementine peel counted as not eaten; whole fruit with peel is about 95–100 g
About 20 grapes at about 5.5 g each
The 5 strawberry halves come from about 3 medium-large strawberries
No sauces, oils or drinks are on the plate
